children: Two meanings of hold:
strategic hold means continued ownership and operation; a review status of Hold means pause the affected activity until blockers are resolved.

Your output is a Strategic Decision Memo. Use controls/capital/diligence/expansion/governance91–95,strategic options96,valuation97 and leadership98. Do not assume a sale or separation is required. Holding and improving can be a valid strategic decision.
Define the objective.
Entity/venture boundary,mission,cash horizon,owner liquidity and leadership capacity. Founder role,CEO role and ownership are distinct.
Compare the paths.
Hold/improve,independent separation,partial/full exit and defer/research. Use consistent horizon,currency and evidence. There is no guaranteed buyer,timeline or best option.
Clarify spin-off meaning.

A formal shareholder spin-off commonly involves distributing subsidiary shares;private venture separation may use different ownership/funding structures. Do not assume these are interchangeable or tax-free. Qualified advisers determine actual structure.
Test holding.
Cash needs,retention/economics,strategic fit and risks of continued ownership. Compare improvements and staged capital needs rather than treating no sale as no decision.
Test independence.

Separate leadership,budget,capital,IP/contracts/data/people and operating capacity. Identify shared-service dependencies,separation costs and required consents. A product or new brand alone is not standalone viability.
Test exit outcomes.

Partial/full sale,asset/share structure and payment timing have different obligations. Headline value is not net founder proceeds;debt,transaction costs,tax,ownership preferences,escrow,earn-outs or retained stakes may matter. No tax/payout formula is assumed here.
Protect stakeholders.
Customer/team/partner continuity,owner conflicts,founder support and obligations after change. Existing responsibilities do not automatically disappear at a sale.
Gate the process.

Actual governance authority,qualified legal/financial/tax review,diligence,confidentiality,permissions and financing/consents. Buyer interest is not signed/closed consideration;spin-off plan is not transferred shares or assets.
Keep fallback.
What if no buyer,no funding,delayed close or separation cannot proceed? Preserve cash,service continuity,no-deal option and Hold conditions.
Recommend a next step.
Evidence-limited hold/improve,separation investigation,exit preparation,research or Hold with owner/date/conditions. Carry source gaps into Lesson100 dossier;no external action executes.
Fictional parent-company route

A parent considers holding a venture,preparing an independent unit with leadership and capital,or exploring a sale. Shared IP,customer contracts and support costs remain unresolved. Investigate viability and rights first;do not promise a one-year exit or founder payout. This is not an actual LYNQ transaction recommendation.
